The '''Nighthawks''' were a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] that were [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Paling]], and were a subdivision out of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] "[[Storm Unit (team)|Storm Unit]]." The Nighthawks participated in Rebel assaults, such as at the [[Nomlis III]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bretie Facility]].

==History==
[[Commander/Legends|Led]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Paling]], the Nighthawks were an [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] "[[Storm Unit (team)|Storm Unit]]" [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were one of several "Storm Unit" squads called upon during the war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to board [[Imperial Navy/Legends|enemy]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] and installations.

Their mission profiles included:
*[[Battle in the Turkana system|Recovering]] important [[Data-tape/Legends|information]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Talon (Imperial corvette)|''Talon'']],
*Rescuing [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war from Imperial prison [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] ''[[VTR-LX]]'',
*[[Slicer/Legends|Stealing data]] from the [[Nomlis III]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bretie Facility]], an experimental factory producing prototype [[TIE starfighter]]s for the [[TIE Experimental Project]], then planting [[Bomb/Legends|explosives]] to destroy the facility,
*Defusing a bomb planted on the [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]].

After the successful mission during the [[Nomlis III]] assault, Paling sent an [[e-mail]] of thanks on behalf of the Nighthawks to [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]].
